zh.title: easyJet A320 關閉左發動機後平安降落阿姆斯特丹
zh.summary: easyJet 由利物浦飛往阿姆斯特丹的 U2-3443 航班在途中宣告緊急，隨後關閉左側發動機。
body: 據 The Aviation Herald 報導，easyJet 的 U2-3443 航班11月20日由英國利物浦飛往荷蘭阿姆斯特丹。執飛的是註冊號 G-EZTC 的空中巴士 A320-200，當時飛機在諾裏奇北方巡航。
機組通報左側發動機出現問題並宣告緊急，隨後關閉該具發動機。航機繼續飛越北海，在宣告緊急後約30分鐘，於阿姆斯特丹史基浦機場06跑道平安落地。
報導指原定回程航班取消，涉事客機在落地約22小時後仍停在阿姆斯特丹。報導未確認發動機出現問題的原因。

en.title: easyJet A320 shuts down left engine and lands safely in Amsterdam
en.summary: The crew of Liverpool–Amsterdam flight U2-3443 declared an emergency after a left-engine problem.
body: An easyJet Airbus A320-200 flying from Liverpool to Amsterdam experienced a left-engine problem on November 20, The Aviation Herald reported. Flight U2-3443 was operated by G-EZTC and was cruising north of Norwich when the crew declared an emergency.
The crew shut down the affected engine. The aircraft continued across the North Sea and landed safely on runway 06 at Amsterdam Schiphol about 30 minutes later.
The report said the return flight was cancelled and the aircraft was still at Amsterdam about 22 hours after landing. The source did not establish the cause of the engine problem.

facts.claim: U2-3443 declared an emergency after a left-engine problem and shut down that engine.
G-EZTC landed safely in Amsterdam about 30 minutes later.
